title: Hearing on community board resources and structure
summary: The Council's Governmental Operations Committee held an oversight hearing examining the structure, staffing and resources available to New York City's 59 community boards, including borough president appointments, district managers and Civic Engagement Commission support. The hearing also covered related bills on AI-manipulated election content disclosure, a Staten Island flag law, council member appointment powers to community boards, district manager employment terms and insider trading on prediction markets by policymakers.
